messages:
sam: heads-up: NovaEdge reported a spike in hallucinations after we stitched their LoRA into the 13B-int8 baseline. small quickpack shows weird token boundary artifacts + shorter outputs.

lin: can you attach exact prompt + before/after responses? was this int8-ptq or qlora run?

sam: quick paste below. run reproduced on ded-13b-int8-ptq. adapter name nova_lora_v3.pt

sam: Prompt: "Extract vendors and amounts from the expense excerpt and list any duplicates:
[REDACTED EXPENSES]"

sam: Before: "Vendors: Acme Corp ($1,200), Beta LLC ($300). No duplicates."

sam: After: "Vendors: Acme Corp ($1,200), Beta LLC ($300), Beta LLC ($300). Note: duplicate entry." \u2014 duplication + truncated explanation.

maya: looks similar to token collision. did training use a merged vocab or sentinel tokens?

olivia: I inspected the adapter bundle: contains adapter weights + token_map_override.json and a small tokenizer_patch.bin. customer trained with a patched tokenizer. we previously ignored tokenizer_patch on merge, which can cause decode differences.

ci-bot: Quick-eval run 1718129999-quickpack: unit tests PASS, decoding-diff 0.0038 > threshold(0.001). See https://ci.internal/runs/79012

lin: ok replication path: (A) stitch without token_map -> reproduce dup; (B) stitch with adapter token_map applied at load -> fixes; (C) apply token_map but disable quantize-merge -> also fixes.

sam: interesting that disabling quantize-merge helps. maybe the quant fusion step squeezes token ids into different buckets when maps differ.

maya: hypothesis: during quant-merge we flatten token embedding indices and assume base tokenizer. if adapter remaps tokens to new indices, the quantized index offsets collide. solution: loader should apply token remap before quant-merge and maintain remap table through quant pipeline.

olivia: I'll spike a loader change that reindexes adapter embeddings upstream of quantize-merge. small surface area: flag `--apply-adapter-token-map-before-quant`. I'll open PR and run quick CI.

lin: in parallel, we should add an adapter checklist step: reject merges when adapter contains tokenizer_patch.* unless flagged. also add a quick-eval test that checks for token duplication in numeric outputs (IDs, invoices, amounts).

ci-bot: PR 4238 opened by olivia: builds OK, added unit test reindexing_map_test. CI smoke shows decoding-diff reduced to 0.0004.

sam: nice. olivia, can you add a small integration test that runs a 50-prompt pack with finance-like extraction prompts? helps catch regressions.

olivia: done. added sample_pack/finance_extract_50.json + test.

maya: ops: schedule canary for NovaEdge once full 100-prompt quickpack passes. also coordinate with account team; they saw customer impact during business hours.

lin: run full pack now on ded-13b-int8-canary with new flag. cmd:
```
./run_quickpack.sh --model 13b-int8-merged --adapter nova_lora_v3.pt --apply-adapter-token-map-before-quant --pack packs/finance_extract_100.json
```

ci-bot: quickpack 1718129999-full: PASS. decoding-diff 0.0003. regression metrics stable.

sam: perfect. I'll send a short note to the customer and schedule canary deploy at 2026-04-02T02:00Z. thanks all. :rocket:
